statement: For iid uniformly elliptic nearest-neighbor RWRE with P_0(X_n^1 -> +infinity)=1, let D={T_{-1}=infinity}, p=P_0(D)>0, Q=P_0(.|D), L the first conditioned true-word height gain and T its duration. Then E_Q L=1/p and positive coordinate liminf speed holds iff E_Q T<infinity.
assumptions: d>=2; iid site transition rows; nearest-neighbor; deterministic uniform ellipticity; annealed almost-sure transience in e1; standard iid true-word regeneration theorem under Q.

source.locator: Proposition 3.5, Corollary 3.6, Lemma 3.10 and Theorem 3.7; PDF indices 44-46

proof_or_counterexample: Fresh-row factorization gives Q(level n is true boundary)=u_n=P_0(T_n<T_-1). The renewal generating function is U(z)=1/(1-E_Q z^L); u_n->p gives (1-z)U(z)->p; monotone convergence gives (1-E_Q z^L)/(1-z)->E_Q L. Hence E_Q L=1/p. Strong laws and the true-word height sandwich give the speed equivalence, including E_Q T=infinity via truncation.
